changes.title: Waze is getting a bunch of new AI-powered features
changes.summary: Waze is getting an AI makeover. Google is integrating its flagship AI assistant, Gemini, into the driving app with the goal of letting users personalize their trips a little more. Of the four new updates, only two are being described as involving Gemini. Waze says its updating its conversation reporting feature, first.

changes.title: When managing your money, take a chatbot's 'confidence' with a grain of salt
changes.summary: According to a 2025 survey of 2,000 U.S. adults by Pearl.com, a professional services platform, 19% said they lost more than $100 by following financial advice from an AI chatbot.

changes.title: Lorde says Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses are ‘not sexy’
changes.summary: Lorde performing at the 2026 Governors Ball. | Photo: Siegfried Anthony/Billboard via Getty Images Lorde was performing at the Real Cool Festival in Madrid on Thursday and took some time during her set to speak out against AI glasses . While she didn't specify any brands in particular, it's likely she was taking a shot.

changes.title: Machine learning calibration of biosensors for microcystin toxin monitoring in freshwater
changes.summary: Portable screen-printed carbon electrode (SPCE) biosensors offer a rapid, low-cost way to detect microcystin-lysine-arginine (MC-LR), an extremely potent toxin produced by cyanobacteria during harmful algal blooms in freshwater. changes.title: Campaign text messages could soon get more effective — and annoying
changes.summary: Taught to sound like a candidate, bots are engaging voters with personalized text messages, making AI-generated texting conversations the latest tool political campaigns are using to connect. (Image credit: Charly Triballeau).

changes.title: Apple’s failed self-driving car program left a legacy of powerful AI chips
changes.summary: Apple's self-driving car program never really got off the ground , but it may have been what made the company's chips the powerful AI performers they are.
